182.csv::61.source_text:
移動中の戦士たちにも情報を共有して
効率よく補給ができるように
取り計らってもらわないとね――
182.csv::61.translated_text:
Must share the intel with soldiers on the move
too, bespeak matters so resupply runs efficient...
182.csv::61.speaker: Versa

182.csv::81.source_text:
あのさ、移動中の魔軍を見つけたんだ
そこまで重装備でも大隊でもないから
戦力を整えさえすれば、十分に勝機が見込めるよ
182.csv::81.translated_text:
We found a Demon Army unit on the move.
Not heavily armed, not e&amp;amp;amp;amp;#x27;en a full battalion—
ready our forces proper, and we&amp;amp;amp;amp;#x27;ve a
solid shot at victory.
182.csv::81.speaker: Dana

182.csv::39.source_text: 追跡開始します――時間内に痕跡を発見しましょう
182.csv::39.translated_text:
Pursuit begins — find the traces ere
time runs out.
182.csv::39.speaker: Guy

182.csv::49.source_text:
素材として使えそうな物の
サンプル収集をお願いね
これもスポット情報の調査には
欠かせないんだ
182.csv::49.translated_text:
Pray, gather samples of anything that might serve
as material—in truth, this too is essential to
the Spot Info investigation.
182.csv::49.speaker: Versa

182.csv::50.source_text:
そうね――
素材として使えそうな物の収集か
魔物出没状況の調査か
どちらかをお願いできない？
182.csv::50.translated_text:
I s&amp;amp;amp;amp;#x27;pose it comes down to this... Gather some
materials that might be of use, or perhaps track
where the monsters be lurking? Could I ask you to
do one or the other, eh?
182.csv::50.speaker: Versa

182.csv::83.source_text:
覚者さんも現地に向かってほしいんだ
一人じゃ危ないから、一緒に戦いやすい応援を
要請しておくのを忘れないでね
182.csv::83.translated_text:
I would have you, Ser Arisen, make for the site
as well. &amp;amp;amp;#x27;Tis too dangerous to go alone — I shall
see to it that proper backup is requested, the
sort that fights well alongside you. Do be sure
not to forget to put in the request.
182.csv::83.speaker: Dana

182.csv::84.source_text:
ふむ――
お考えがまとまったら
なるべく早めにご相談ください
182.csv::84.translated_text:
Hm— When your thoughts are settled...
Pray, come speak with me as soon as you are able.
182.csv::84.speaker: Artin

182.csv::302.source_text:
彼の者の討伐を――どうか――
火竜様なき今、あなただけが頼りなのです
182.csv::302.translated_text:
I beseech you— prithee, the subjugation of that
creature— For with Lord Fire Dragon gone, you
alone are the one upon whom we must rely.
182.csv::302.speaker: Doris

182.csv::25.source_text:
それでは、＜&amp;amp;amp;lt;STG 1093&amp;amp;amp;gt;＞へお急ぎください
協力者の方も、一足先に
現地で待っているはずですわ
182.csv::25.translated_text:
Then, pray make haste to &amp;amp;amp;lt;STG 1093&amp;amp;amp;gt;. 
Your collaborator awaits at the site,
having arrived afore you.
182.csv::25.speaker: Nazik

182.csv::413.source_text:
さぁ、各地から
イケてるメンズをスカウトしてきたわ
プレゼントの準備はいいかしら
182.csv::413.translated_text: Right then, I've scouted some fine fellows from all over. Are the Presents ready?
182.csv::413.speaker: Shelly

182.csv::414.source_text:
今年も&amp;amp;quot;１人にだけ&amp;amp;quot;プレゼントしてね
他の人にはプレゼントできないから
よーく考えてから渡すのよ
182.csv::414.translated_text: This year too, you're only givin' a Present to "just one person"! Can't give 'em to anyone else, so think real careful before you hand it over!
182.csv::414.speaker: Shelly

182.csv::415.source_text:
それじゃあさっそく、全員から
アピールを聞いてみましょう！
182.csv::415.translated_text: Well then, let's hear everyone's appeals right away!
182.csv::415.speaker: Shelly

182.csv::416.source_text:
今年のメンズもなかなかのイケメン揃いじゃないか
まあ、シェリーちゃん的には
俺は&amp;amp;quot;殿堂入り&amp;amp;quot;らしくてね
はっはっはっは！
182.csv::416.translated_text:
This year's men are quite the handsome lot, eh?
Well, as far as Ms. Shelly's concerned,
I'm 'Hall of Fame' material, so they say.
Hah hah hah!
182.csv::416.speaker: Angelo

182.csv::417.source_text:
今年も&amp;amp;quot;１人にだけ&amp;amp;quot;プレゼントしてね
他の人にはプレゼントできないから
よーく考えてから渡すのよ
182.csv::417.translated_text: This year too, you're only givin' a Present to "just one person"! Can't give 'em to anyone else, so think real careful before you hand it over!
182.csv::417.speaker: Shelly

182.csv::418.source_text:
それじゃあさっそく、全員から
意気込みを聞いてみましょう！
182.csv::418.translated_text: Right then, let's hear everyone's resolve straight away!
182.csv::418.speaker: Shelly

182.csv::419.source_text:
その顔は、まだ誰に贈るか悩んでいるな？
じっくりゆっくり考えていいぞ
182.csv::419.translated_text: That face says you're still ponderin' who to gift it to, eh? Take your good time thinkin' it over.
182.csv::419.speaker: Angelo

182.csv::420.source_text:
なんなら俺が貰ってもいいんだが
ほら～、隣にシェリーちゃんという天使がいるもので
いやぁ悪いね！　悪いね～！
182.csv::420.translated_text:
I wouldn't mind takin' it meself, mind.
See, there's an angel—Ms. Shelly—right beside me.
Bad form! Bad form~!
182.csv::420.speaker: Angelo

182.csv::421.source_text:
ちゃんと気になる人にプレゼントできたみたいね
それじゃあ、今年の真に選ばれた男子が誰になるか
結果をお楽しみにね！
182.csv::421.translated_text:
Seems you got your present to that special someone just fine!
Well then, who'll be this year's truly chosen gentleman?
Do look forward to the results!
182.csv::421.speaker: Shelly

182.csv::422.source_text:
私？　私は今から
プレゼントを贈るところよ
182.csv::422.translated_text: Me? I'm just about to give a Present.
182.csv::422.speaker: Shelly

182.csv::423.source_text:
誰にって――決まってるじゃない！
私にはアンジェロしかいないわ！
182.csv::423.translated_text: Who, you ask—it's obvious! There's no one but Angelo for me!
182.csv::423.speaker: Shelly

182.csv::424.source_text:
いやぁ、結果が楽しみだなぁ～！
ふっふっふ、そりゃあ余裕だよ
シェリーちゃんの一番は俺に決まってるからね
182.csv::424.translated_text:
Ahh, I'm fair itching for the results!
Heh heh heh, easy as can be.
'Cos Ms. Shelly's number one is yours truly, decided and done.
182.csv::424.speaker: Angelo

182.csv::425.source_text:
またコレか！
この手の祭りが始まると
エリオットがヤケにはりきりやがる
きっとまたうるせぇことになるぞ
182.csv::425.translated_text: Not this again! When festivals like this start up, Elliot gets all fired up. Bound to be a right racket again.
182.csv::425.speaker: Gurdolin

182.csv::426.source_text:
それにしても、ここにずっと座ってるのも
なかなか辛いもんだぜ
この季節だからよ、風が冷てぇんだ
182.csv::426.translated_text: Still, sittin' here all this while... 'tis a proper misery. This season, the wind's biting cold.
182.csv::426.speaker: Gurdolin

182.csv::427.source_text:
はぁ――で、お前も何か用意してんのか？
なんだよ、聞いてみただけだろうが
182.csv::427.translated_text:
Hah—so you got aught prepared too?
What, just askin' is all.
182.csv::427.speaker: Gurdolin

182.csv::428.source_text:
俺んところに持ってくるってなら
断る理由は無いけどよ
182.csv::428.translated_text:
If you're bringin' it to me,
ain't no reason to refuse, though.
182.csv::428.speaker: Gurdolin

182.csv::429.source_text:
ここに呼ばれちゃ、誰が１位かって
"いつもの"賭けがやりにくいぜ
182.csv::429.translated_text: Bein' called here makes the usual bet on who'll be first a right pain.
182.csv::429.speaker: Gurdolin

182.csv::430.source_text:
もしかして、ジョゼフあたりの策略か？
ここに俺の席を用意して
大人しくさせようって魂胆じゃねぇだろうな
182.csv::430.translated_text: Don't tell me this is Joseph's doin'? Set a seat for me here just to keep me quiet, eh.
182.csv::430.speaker: Gurdolin

182.csv::431.source_text:
いやぁ、異国のおめでたい席に
呼ばれるなんて僕も偉くなったものだなぁ！
182.csv::431.translated_text: Well now, invited to a foreign celebration — I really have made it big, haven't I!
182.csv::431.speaker: Sonel

182.csv::432.source_text:
で、そこの舞台に立ってるお二人が
新郎新婦ってことなのかい？
僕も何かスピーチした方がいいかな
182.csv::432.translated_text: So, the two on stage there... they're the bride and groom? Should I give a speech too?
182.csv::432.speaker: Sonel
